metadata.title: Broadcom Stock Tumbles as AI Growth Soars 221%. The Problem Is Investor Expectations

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) shares fell about 5% after the chipmaker posted another sharp increase in artificial-intelligence revenue, with the market appearing to focus more on future expectations than current growth.
AI semiconductor sales reached $16.7 billion in the latest quarter, up 221% from a year earlier and 54% from the prior quarter. Total revenue increased 86% to $29.59 billion, while adjusted earnings rose to $3.32 a share.
Broadcom also lifted its fiscal 2027 AI semiconductor revenue outlook to about $115 billion from more than $100 billion previously. It expects roughly $230 billion in the category for fiscal 2028, suggesting management sees demand continuing to expand.
Still, the fourth-quarter forecast of $34.8 billion in total revenue came in slightly below the $35.03 billion analyst estimate cited in the report. That gap may have amplified concerns that investors were already pricing in a larger upside surprise.
Competition in custom AI chips is another consideration, particularly as major technology companies develop alternatives for their data centers.
Broadcom's AI growth remains robust, but elevated expectations could keep shares sensitive to even modest guidance gaps.
